## 04 Tailor applications
Started by the scheduler (workflow 00), by default every 15 minutes: asks the service to tailor the next shortlisted jobs (3 per run by default). For each job it drafts a resume patch and cover letter, checks them against your resume (two honesty layers), renders the PDFs, stores them in `output/applications/`, and, in review mode, sends them to your Telegram.

**Settings live in the database, not here:** `scripts/jobsearch tailor-settings` (mode, approval, score band, daily limit, cover letter, fact check) or `/settings` in Telegram. In **manual** mode this workflow does nothing.

It is capped by your spending limits (see docs/budget.md). **Credentials needed:** none (the service holds the keys).
